description: finance_social_security — Social Security claiming-age calculator: full retirement age from birth date (SSA Jan-1 rule), earliest claim month, early-claim reduction and delayed retirement credits for every age 62-70, monthly benefit from your PIA, lifetime totals to a life expectancy, break-even ages (62 vs FRA vs 70) and the best claim age. Params: birth_date=YYYY-MM-DD (required), pia= (monthly benefit at full retirement age), claim_age= (e.g. 64.5), life_expectancy= (default 85). Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_social_security
